messages:
monica_pm: Quick heads up — we need a compact preflight for the joint press + SKU alignment ahead of next week's vendor calls. Focus: H200 slotting, MI300 SKU tags, and Gaudi SI readiness. Can folks drop blockers by EOD? :eyes:

alex.k: Noted. I can pull the marketplace SKU mapping and current embargo windows. Will post a diff shortly.

rachel_eng: Engineering: lab tests for Gaudi micro-bench are green, but MI300 quantization builds flipped one perf regression on 2x sequence. Need an ETA on a kernel patch from infra.

tim_ops: Ops: capacity-wise we can commit 2x H200 nodes of reserved capacity for the earliest wave. Need confirmation on required p95 latency target to size appropriately.

vendor_amd: From vendor side — MI300 supply ETA still holds but firmware image v1.4 must be on the units for SI. We'll share the image and release notes today.

alex.k: Good — can you attach the firmware release notes here? Also we need explicit embargo windows for press. Last time timing mismatch caused an internal handoff issue.

vendor_amd: attaching: https://example.com/mi300-v1.4-release-notes (partner link). Embargo window requested: 2024-07-15 -> 2024-07-22 (internal).

monica_pm: Copy. @tim_ops can you target a dry-run cutover on 2024-07-10 to validate SI installflows and marketplace SKU tags? If anything breaks we push the public announce.

tim_ops: 2024-07-10 dry-run ok. I'll schedule staging window 02:00-06:00 PST and tag infra oncall. Need the SKU mappings by 07/08.

alex.k: SKU mapping draft:
```
- mi300-x1-standard -> marketplace-sku: MI300-ST-01
- h200-x2-lowlatency -> marketplace-sku: H200-LL-02
- gaudi-s1-large -> marketplace-sku: GAUDI-LG-03
```
I'll publish PR for review. Please verify naming and channel availability.

rachel_eng: Confirm GAUDI-LG-03 matches lab image tags. One ask: can we include a quantization profile label on MI300 SKUs (q8/q4) so runtime can pick kernels automatically?

alex.k: Good call — will extend mapping with label: quant_profile:[q8,q4].

vendor_nvidia: Quick FYI from NVIDIA folks: H100->H200 compatibility note — fallback drivers are fine but there's a perf delta if customers use old kernels. We'll send recommended kernel versions for the marketplace images.

monica_pm: Two coordination asks for marketing/press:
1) Do we have an embargo handoff owner for each vendor? 2) What's the canonical customer-facing SKU doc we point press to (link)?

maria_marketing: I'll own embargo handoff for Redwood. Drafting the FAQ and canonical doc: https://redwood.docs.internal/marketplace-skus (WIP). Recommend we lock copy by 07/09.

devon_se: For SI integrators: list of test cases for cutover. I'll drop a short runbook later today. Early ask: do we require H200 smoke tests to run with cached KV state? That changes the test duration.

rachel_eng: Yes, include KV cache persistence check for H200. Adds ~12m per run.

monica_pm: Nice. Action items summary (quick):
```
- alex.k: publish SKU PR + add quant_profile labels (by 07/08)
- vendor_amd: deliver MI300 v1.4 image + release notes (today)
- vendor_nvidia: kernel recommendations (today)
- tim_ops: schedule staging dry-run 07/10 and oncall (by 07/08)
- devon_se: SI runbook + test matrix (EOD)
- maria_marketing: embargo handoff doc + FAQ (lock by 07/09)
- rachel_eng: validate GAUDI lab tags and confirm KV test time (by 07/08)
```

alex.k: I'll also add a short checklist for the press handoff and a single Slack channel for the live window. Proposed channel: #hw-announce-handoff. Approve?

monica_pm: Approve. Add partner reps and eng leads.

vendor_amd: We'll add our comms rep to that channel once created.

deploy-bot: ci/cd: sku-mapping-pr #342 passed integration checks — https://ci.redwood/342 :white_check_mark:

monica_pm: Great progress. If no objections, I'll lock this thread and post a final preflight summary tomorrow morning with links to PRs and the dry-run calendar invite. :rocket:
